svg.title: Extremal binary matrices with no all-ones 3 by 3 submatrix from one square: 19 by 21 with 177 ones, the 193-one square without its two eight-one rows; 20 by 21 with 185, the 177-one rectangle plus an outlined eight-one row; and 21 by 21 with 193, the 185-one rectangle plus an outlined eight-one row.
